review.use_summary: Used Monocle3 1.0.0 on the reported UMAT embedding to reconstruct lineage trajectories and select shortest paths; a modified graph_test with covariates identified trajectory-associated genes.
review.implementation_scope_note: The paper reports UMAT, gene/cell filtering, selected paths and a modified covariate-aware Moran test. Do not silently rename the embedding, infer the custom implementation or equate stock graph_test with its sex/batch/PMI/log_n_genes-adjusted version. The native component handles only supplied projected-graph ordering; graph learning, the modified test, metacell smoothing, spline models and clustering remain separate workflow requirements.

review.use_summary: Compared Monocle 3 pseudotime through the separate py-monocle Python wrapper with neural-network predictions and Palantir in microglia; tried 200 eligible starting cells and retained the highest Braak-stage correlation.
review.implementation_scope_note: The exact Monocle/wrapper edition and graph options are unstated. py-monocle is named executable software and requires its own source/runtime review; an R adapter does not establish wrapper parity. Starting-cell eligibility and selection using observed Braak correlation are part of this comparison, not a general root-selection default or independent predictive validation. Native prepared-graph ordering does not reproduce that selection pipeline.

review.use_summary: Used Cicero for Monocle 3 to infer cis-co-accessible cCRE pairs per cell subclass, using mm10, default Cicero parameters and 500 kb genomic windows.
review.implementation_scope_note: This paragraph identifies Monocle as the platform for Cicero and does not establish a Monocle trajectory/pseudotime run. Cicero, shuffled-background fitting, FDR filtering and distal/proximal annotation are distinct analyses. Exact Monocle/Cicero patches and author-specific preparation remain unresolved; do not credit them to the native pseudotime component or a stock Monocle trajectory adapter.

review.use_summary: Applied the Monocle3 pipeline with Batchelor 1.20.0 integration, Monocle3 1.3.7 dimensional reduction/clustering and pseudotime; a separate Wilcoxon test compared immature control and Tgfbr2-mutant cells.
review.implementation_scope_note: The complete paragraph explicitly reports Monocle3 1.3.7, correcting the unreviewed missing-version extraction. Exact preprocessing, integration settings, graph controls, roots and transformations are unstated. The separate Wilcoxon test used continuity correction. The current 1.4.27 readiness profile and native prepared-graph component do not establish historical 1.3.7/Batchelor parity or that complete experiment.

review.use_summary: Used monocle3 1.3.1 fit_models GLMs to relate spatial gene expression to amyloid Getis-Ord Gi* hotspot scores, adjusting for biological sample and UMI count; followed significant Wald-test results with positive Pearson-correlation filtering.
review.implementation_scope_note: This is gene-wise GLM inference, not Monocle pseudotime. The model family, exact formula/encoding, normalization and full testing family are unstated. Human grey-matter filtering, mouse regional fits, separate stains and subsequent Pearson filtering remain explicit upstream/downstream steps. The attempted original 1.3.1 runtime is skipped because grr does not compile under R 4.6.1; a current 1.4.27 synthetic quasipoisson probe is not a silent version/family substitution.

review.use_summary: Used Monocle 2 differentialGeneTest for differential gene expression across cell types, with reported FDR, fold-change and TPM marker filters.
review.implementation_scope_note: Other named Methods paragraphs apply Monocle 2 tests to subclusters, age/AD comparisons with sex covariates, cell fractions, accessibility peaks and human AD/control expression. They require separate source pointers and preserve their distinct sampling/filtering populations. The exact patch, expression family, formulas and normalization are not fully resolved. TPM marker cutoffs do not establish count-model input eligibility. Monocle 3 GLMs or native pseudotime are not interchangeable with these Monocle 2 likelihood-ratio workflows.

review.use_summary: Constructed trajectories on selected transition regions with monocle3 1.3.3 learn_graph, varying ncenter across 130/140/150 and minimal_branch_len across 15/20, with close_loop=FALSE; ordered from a terminal node in the assumed transition direction.
review.implementation_scope_note: The exact selected embedding population, root identifier and mapping of graph-control combinations to transitions are unstated. The controls and assumed direction must remain explicit. Native ordering of a supplied projected graph covers only the final geodesic step. The current 1.4.27 readiness probe does not validate original 1.3.3 graph learning or infer those missing paper choices.

review.use_summary: Inferred Monocle pseudotrajectories from metaVIPER protein-activity profiles of 1,856 malignant pancreatic cells, alongside separate Seurat/Louvain state clustering.
review.implementation_scope_note: The Monocle generation/patch, model family, graph algorithm/options and roots are unstated. Protein-activity values must not be treated as raw RNA counts or assumed eligible for a count-model adapter. Native prepared-graph ordering requires the caller to supply the actual matched embedding/graph; metaVIPER/ARACNe inference, clustering, cross-cohort enrichment and biological state interpretation remain separate analyses.
